user.title: Audio Control
user.description: Select a device profile and enter the connection. Use a local serial port (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0), a network URL (e.g. socket://192.168.1.50:4999), or 'demo' to try the integration with a simulated device and no hardware. Detected locally: {suggested_ports}.

custom_basic.title: Custom Device - Basic Info
custom_basic.description: Name your device and configure zones, sources, and serial speed.

custom_serial.title: Custom Device - Serial Framing
custom_serial.description: Define how commands are wrapped for the connection. Use \r for carriage return, \n for newline.

data.response_prefix: Response Prefix (stripped from responses, e.g., # or >)

custom_commands.title: Custom Device - Commands
custom_commands.description: Define the device commands. Placeholders are written in braces: zone, source and volume. A format spec may follow a colon, so a zero-padded 2-digit zone is zone:02d in braces. See the docs for examples.

custom_response.title: Custom Device - Response Parsing
custom_response.description: Define how to parse the device's response using a Python regular expression with named groups for zone, power, volume, source and mute. Example: a 2-digit zone group followed by PWR and a 1-digit power group. See the docs for a full pattern.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Audio Control
reconfigure.description: Change the connection for this device without removing it. Use a local serial port, a network URL (e.g., socket://192.168.1.50:4999 or rfc2217://192.168.1.50:4999), or 'demo'. Detected locally: {suggested_ports}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter device credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials, or did not answer the login. Enter the current username and password for {device}. Leave a field blank to keep its stored value.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check connection.
error.invalid_profile: Selected device profile could not be loaded.
error.invalid_regex: Invalid regular expression. Check for unmatched brackets or parentheses, and that each named group appears only once.
error.credentials_required: Enter a username or a password. Submitting both blank would retry the credentials that just failed.

abort.reauth_successful: Credentials updated and the device reconnected.

not_valid_zone.message: Entity {entity_id} is not a valid Audio Control zone.

command_failed.message: Failed to send {command} for zone {zone}. Check the device connection.

integration_unavailable.message: Audio Control integration is not available.

unknown_source.message: Source {source} is not available on this device. Available: {available}.

unsupported_tone_level.message: Tone level {level} is not supported by this device. Allowed levels: {allowed}.

zone_off_tone.message: Zone {zone} is off. Turn the zone on before changing bass or treble.

no_target_zones.message: The target does not include any Audio Control zones.

init.title: Rename Zones & Sources
init.description: Give your zones and sources the names you use at home. They appear on the dashboard and in automations.

data.login_username: Device username (leave blank to keep the profile default)
data.login_password: Device password (leave blank to keep the profile default)
